title: The Phantom Proxy: A Digital Attendance Fraud
dispute_text: A student marked attendance via proxy during the OOP C++ lab session
setting: CSE Lab 3, Computer Science Department, Friday 2PM lab session
summary: During a compulsory Object-Oriented Programming in C++ lab session, attendance was logged for Priya Sharma — but digital forensics reveal her code submission came from an off-campus IP address at the exact same time. Someone signed in for her.

Her friend Neha had access to her credentials
